notes.title: 👹 Devil Can Beat is Ready for Rhythm Fest! 👹
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Devil Can Beat is now live on Steam as part of the Rhythm Fest! Control a demon on a quest for the devil's melody in this rhythm-driven adventure. Your feedback is crucial to us, so dive into the demo, enjoy the beats, and let us know what you think!

And don't forget to share your level scores with us—we'd love to see how you’re mastering the game!

Don’t miss out—play the demo now and experience the rhythm of the underworld!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130827/50b5f986466d5aa0cbaffc90f303dd1b590ba691.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 👹 Devil Can Beat - Demo Available Now! 👹
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers! We’re excited to share the demo of "Devil Can Beat," a game created by our small but passionate team. In this adventure, you'll step into the shoes of a devil seeking the Devil’s Chord.

What’s in the Demo?

🕹️ Explore Dungeons - Each dungeon has its own unique rhythm. Clear them to reach the powerful bosses that await you.

💥 Collect Orbs - Gather orbs to enhance your shield, attack power, and dash range. Every orb gives you an edge against your enemies.

🔧 Upgrade Your Character - At the end of each level, choose from three different power-ups that fit your playstyle and make your devil stronger.

🎶 Defeat Bosses - Each boss holds a piece of the Devil’s Chord. Defeat them all to unlock the full power of rhythm.

We truly appreciate your support and would love to hear your feedback. Please download the demo and share your thoughts with us.

Thank you for your support, and may the rhythm be with you!
